thresholds_status: user-task proposals fixed before pilot; not optical industry standards
selection: At each size fit fixed families with train order11. Confirm gate-passing family at same size on train orders22/33. Smallest size passing every gate for all3 orders; tie by mean validation tolerance-normalized RMSE. Production fit uses order11. Do not refit after calibration. If none passes through4096, keep best validation model and accuracy_target_met=false.

uncertainty.claims: marginal joint coverage only for exchangeable calibration/test from same reference distribution; not conditional, per-design, boundary or adaptive-search guarantees

spline_interactions.knots_source: training input extrema only; no historic curve knots or generator values

candidate_policy: 20k supplied X only; no oracle labels computed until queried; split guards exclude all supervised/parity/legacy-test IDs
pilot_policy: Only train/validation. No calibrated intervals or final test/challenge model scores in data-creation pilot.
real_solver_evaluation: not_measured; synthetic accuracy is not GMMNLSE accuracy; solver_emulation needs distinct labeled source and frozen protocol
protocol_history: Error tolerances fixed before initial pilot. Spline-interaction family added after development-only comparison; this is model development, not a blind preregistered model comparison. No final test/calibration/challenge model scores used.
